mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which impairs febuxostat clearance and increases uric acid rebound risk; febuxostat may exacerbate renal dysfunction through urate crystal nephropathy.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust febuxostat dosing based on creatinine clearance; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy.
